limits: Native default-constructor and allocation failure equivalence remain open. Native partial default construction can leak storage; Rust safely drops initialized prefixes, deliberately tested without parity credit.
Native primitive uninitialized default storage has no general safe Rust value equivalent.
Explicit callbacks and Clone::clone_from select assignment policies; arbitrary C++ address-sensitive object, copy/move and lifetime hooks are not automatically inferred.
The owned convenience consumes its donor; native donor retention is modeled by borrowed adapters.
Rust panics model tested assignment-failure traces, not arbitrary native exception types, messages, ABI or noexcept termination.

Safe row-before-column validation rejects negative ranges before defaults/assignment. OCCT uses signed arithmetic and unsigned conversion; invalid/overflowing ranges are not treated as a defined matching oracle.
Send+Sync+static bounds and lock guards restrict native type, aliasing and reentrant access domains.
No complete wrapper, implicit special-member, inherited alias/RTTI/allocation or denominator-complete proof is claimed.
